baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional joins تَكْفُرُوا, everyone in the earth جَمِيعًا, and the emphatic لَغَنِيٌّ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah maximizes withheld acknowledgment until no terrestrial respondent is missing, then denies that this total withdrawal creates any need in God. Gratitude is not an input that sustains or enriches him.

activation_trace.role: Covering or denying a blessing supplies the withheld response that the conditional maximizes.
Wholeness without dispersion or deficit makes the stress test exhaustive.
Freedom from need blocks the inference that universal ingratitude could impoverish its object.

changed_reading.before: God remains rich even if people disbelieve.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages total terrestrial withdrawal of acknowledgment as failed leverage: gratitude is not a resource God needs.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَمِيدٌ remains the final predicate after imagined universal kufr and declared divine غنى.
baseline_models.mechanism: Kufr can cover truth or blessing, but it cannot remove the qualities on account of which the object is praised. Placed after غَنِيٌّ, حَمِيدٌ names praiseworthiness that does not depend on a praising public.

activation_trace.role: Veiling truth supplies failed recognition, not alteration of the thing unrecognized.
Independence removes any need for acclaim as support.
The one of many praised qualities supplies an object-grounded basis for praise.

changed_reading.after: حَمِيدٌ is not crowd-produced reputation: universal covering can erase recognition while leaving the ground of praise intact.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, gratitude is coupled to increase and kufr to consequence. Since the focus then denies divine need, the increase or loss cannot be a gain or deficit in God; it belongs on the responding human side. The branch in which a little suffices and its effect appears sharpens gratitude as receptive amplification.

activation_trace.role: Divine non-need redirects the adjacent gain and loss toward recipients.
A little proving sufficient and showing its effect supplies recipient-side amplification.
Increase and growth supply the explicit result attached to gratitude.
The repeated covering of blessing links the warning's negative branch directly to the focus.

structural_cues: 14:7 and 14:8 are consecutive Mosaic speech, with the second conditional expanding the first from Israel to all earth.
14:5 marks signs for every patient, grateful person, and 14:37 orders fruit provision toward possible gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gratitude followed by increase, kufr followed by consequence, and then divine independence; I assign benefit and damage to the human receiver. A live alternative is direct juridical reward rather than organic amplification, without changing that direction.

changed_reading.before: Independence means human gratitude is irrelevant to God's condition.
changed_reading.after: Independence relocates the causal circuit: gratitude lets received good grow in the receiver, while kufr blocks that uptake without depriving God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Disbelievers call the land theirs and threaten expulsion; God then settles others in it, identifies himself as creator of earth and creation, and finally substitutes earth itself. Thus 'whoever is in the earth' denotes occupants of a replaceable platform, not owners whose unanimity gives them leverage.

activation_trace.role: The terrestrial lower realm anchors the domain whose inhabitants are totalized.
Independence supplies the boundary that occupancy cannot cross.
The same earth is called 'ours,' supplying the inhabitants' apparent territorial leverage.
Settlement in a dwelling supplies reassignment of occupancy after the possessive claim.
Origination of earth and a new creation makes occupants and platform derivative.
One thing standing in place of another supplies terminal replacement of the terrestrial platform.

structural_cues: The expulsion threat in 14:13 is reversed by the settlement promise in 14:14.
The creation conditional in 14:19-20 and earth substitution in 14:48 repeat the contingency of population and setting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claimed land, reassigned settlement, created earth, new creation, and substituted earth; I infer an occupancy-to-tenancy relation. The substitution may be specifically eschatological rather than political, but it still sharpens contingency.

changed_reading.before: Even every inhabitant of earth cannot make God needy.
changed_reading.after: Even unanimous inhabitants remain tenants within a created and replaceable earth; occupancy cannot become leverage against its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the later gathering of everyone, weak followers ask elevated leaders whether they can make them independent of any part of divine punishment. Their inability places creaturely insufficiency opposite the focus's divine غَنِيّ: God needs none, while no terrestrial dependency tier can make another need none.

activation_trace.role: Non-need supplies the absolute pole of the later sufficiency contrast.
Everyone appearing as a complete whole realizes the focus's scope in a dependency scene.
Sufficing another or standing in another's place supplies the capacity the leaders lack.
Lack of strength supplies the dependent party seeking derivative sufficiency.
Claimed greatness supplies the superior human tier that still cannot avail its dependents.

structural_cues: 14:21 repeats both جَمِيعًا and a form of غ ن ي from the focus.
The leaders' answer ends with equalized despair and patience and no escape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact root recurrence and a failed request from weak to great; I infer that the scene defines divine independence by contrast with creaturely dependence. The context form may mean 'avail or protect' rather than full ontological independence, but that sharpens rather than cancels the contrast.

changed_reading.before: غَنِيّ means that God possesses enough and needs no acknowledgment.
changed_reading.after: Independence becomes relational: God alone is non-needing, while even the strongest humans cannot confer sufficient independence on their dependents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus begins as an uttered saying. The later sequence gives a good word stable continuity and recurring yield, gives a bad word total uprooting, then names conversion of blessing into kufr. This activates Moses's conditional as a word offered for rooting: its result occurs in hearers, while the independent God does not need its yield.

activation_trace.role: Speech brought into utterance anchors the focus itself as a word entering reception.
Covering blessing anchors the failed reception named by the Mosaic word.
An intelligible expression broad enough to be a saying supplies the verbal object compared to a tree.
Continuity and stability supply the good word's durable reception.
Tree or crop yield supplies recurring benefit produced by the rooted word.
Being pulled wholly from the root supplies the bad word's loss of productive continuity.
One thing made to stand in place of another supplies conversion rather than mere neglect.
Good condition and blessing supply what is converted at the end of the sequence.
Covering blessing is the replacement outcome, reconnecting the sequence to تَكْفُرُوا.

structural_cues: 14:24-26 form a good-word and bad-word parallel around stability, earth, and yield.
14:27 repeats قَوْل and ث ب ت before 14:28 immediately names blessing changed into kufr.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an uttered focus, a stable fruitful word, an uprooted word, and blessing converted into kufr; I infer that Moses's particular conditional participates in that reception ecology. A live alternative is that the tree analogy concerns a broader confession.

changed_reading.before: Moses's conditional reports what disbelief cannot do to God.
changed_reading.after: The conditional is also a planted diagnostic word: receiving it can root blessing into human yield, while converting blessing into kufr uproots the receiver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later catalogue runs materially toward humans: created earth, apportioned provision, and systems driven for their use, followed by uncountable blessing and renewed kufr. Later الحمد answers a gift given without return. Divine غنى therefore marks a one-way source relation, and human praise is truthful response rather than payment.

activation_trace.role: Non-need fixes the direction of dependence outside the terrestrial network.
The bearer of praised qualities anchors worth independently of compensation.
Origination supplies the source relation for the heavens-and-earth system.
Apportioned giving identifies fruit as provision directed to 'you.'
Driving things toward a purpose supplies ships and rivers as a harnessed service layer.
Good condition and blessing collect the supplied goods under one uncountable relation.
Intensive covering of blessing identifies the recipient's response after the provision catalogue.
Actual praise and thanks supply a human response voiced after benefit.
A gift bestowed without return supplies the noncommercial ground to which praise responds.

structural_cues: Repeated لَكُم in 14:32-33 directs natural systems toward human use.
14:34 moves from what was given to inability to enumerate blessing and ends with intensive kufr.
14:39 orders praise before naming the gifted sons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation, provision, harnessed systems, uncountable blessing, praise, and gift without return; I infer a provider-to-recipient architecture in which praise answers rather than pays. A live alternative is a catalogue of power, but repeated 'for you' preserves the same direction.

changed_reading.before: All inhabitants together cannot diminish God's wealth or praise.
changed_reading.after: All earth is downstream of gift and provision; universal ingratitude occurs inside what God supplies, while responsive praise never becomes remuneration he needs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the seed-covering branch of ك ف ر is agricultural and normally constructive, while the focus form names a condemned response. It remains anchored in تَكْفُرُوا and is activated by stable tree, yield, no-crop valley, and supplied fruit. Render it only as a material analogy distinguishing concealment from ownership of growth, never as a claim that the focus verb means 'to sow.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ك ف ر inventory includes covering seed, while the ayah joins that verb to earth and divine non-need.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed with soil supplies the branch-distant material image for concealment.
Non-need prevents the one who covers from becoming owner or source of concealed growth.
Crop or tree yield supplies growth's recurring human benefit.
Cultivation and growth supply the explicitly absent agricultural capacity of the valley.
Mature fruits in the no-crop setting reconnect growth to gratitude rather than human self-sufficiency.

changed_reading.before: Kufr is refusal or concealment of received blessing.
changed_reading.after: As a contained agricultural overlay, humans may cover a seed-like gift from acknowledgment, but neither its ground nor its power of growth becomes theirs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the song-and-voice branch of غ ن ي beside حَمِيد rather than the adjective's ordinary non-need branch. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and gains coherence from voiced saying, the intelligible word, imagined all-earth silence, and later praise. Call it a sonic overlay only, and do not translate غَنِيّ as 'singer.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Spoken قَالَ leads to غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ after the ayah imagines every terrestrial voice withholding acknowledgment.

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance supplies the sonic frame at the focus opening.
Song and voice supply the branch-distant image of praise that does not depend on an external choir.
Praise as the opposite of blame supplies the sonic overlay's content.
Intelligible speech linking speakers supplies a context where voiced meaning has durable life.
Later voiced praise supplies the human song that can occur without constituting divine worth.

changed_reading.before: God's praiseworthiness persists without human praise.
changed_reading.after: As a contained sonic overlay, an all-earth chorus falling silent cannot silence praise itself: worth does not borrow its song from the audience.

strongest_changes: The 14:7 gratitude-increase sequence plus 14:8 divine non-need relocates gain and loss to the human receiver.
The exact غ ن ي recurrence in 14:21 contrasts God's non-need with powerful humans' inability to make dependents sufficient.
Land, replacement, provision, and gift sequences turn all earth into contingent downstream occupants rather than suppliers of God.
The word-tree sequence makes Moses's conditional an offered word whose rooting or uprooting changes hearers.
summary.what_was_special: Recurrences of ك ف ر, ج م ع, غ ن ي, and ح م د converted a static attribute statement into directional mechanisms of gift, reception, sufficiency, occupancy, and fruiting. The all-earth counterfactual kept each mechanism anchored in failed creaturely leverage.
remaining_uncertainties: The 14:21 غ ن ي contrast may be lexical recurrence without an intended direct echo, though it remains a strong packet-local activation.
Applying the good-word tree specifically to Moses's sentence is a reader-supplied narrowing.
The seed-covering and song branches are exploratory overlays, not lexical replacements.
